name: Daily price-strength continuation
author: Local researcher — replace before specification
explanation: Untested assumption: gradual incorporation of information may produce short-term continuation after sustained price strength.
return_supplier: Assumption: investors adjusting positions gradually may transact after the initial information response.
persistence_reason: Assumption: liquidity constraints and heterogeneous decision horizons may slow adjustment. This explanation has not been established by this application.
universe: Explicitly selected NSE cash equities with complete attributable daily history; current selection may introduce survivorship bias.
liquidity: Evaluate instruments meeting a frozen trailing traded-value threshold; simulated participation limited to 1% of daily volume.
holding_horizon: Five exchange sessions after a simulated next-session opening entry.
information_at_decision: Only daily observations available after the completed session, and sourced corporate actions available before their effective date.
signal_definition: Split-aware close-to-close return over the previous 20 exchange sessions, computed from real observations.
expected_relationship: Untested assumption: positive trailing strength predicts positive subsequent price returns and a positive cross-sectional rank IC where the universe permits.
strengthening_conditions: Predefined descriptive check: higher trailing traded value and persistent price strength. No retrospective regime is used as a tradable filter.
weakening_conditions: The effect may disappear with entry delay, higher costs, concentrated winners or changing liquidity.
alternatives: Market beta, sector exposure, current-universe selection, corporate-action omissions and dominant winners could explain apparent performance.
benchmark: Fixed equal-weight selected-universe buy-and-hold price baseline on identical dates; gross and excluding dividends.
planned_experiments: Baseline on training and validation; lookbacks 10,20,40; one-session additional delay; increased costs. Freeze one version before final holdout access.
bounded_parameters: Lookback in {10,20,40}; holding horizon fixed at five; entry delay in {1,2}. Register every evaluated combination.
primary_metric: Net validation total return alongside the explicitly labeled gross baseline; no composite success score.
diagnostics: Rank IC, forward price returns, drawdown, turnover, costs, exposure, and period/instrument concentration.
rejection_criteria: Reject as useful trading evidence if net out-of-sample return is nonpositive or realistic costs eliminate the result; unresolved data or exposure explanations imply inconclusive.
investigation_criteria: Further review requires positive held-out evidence, tolerable drawdown and costs, bounded-parameter stability, broad contribution and adequate attributable data. This is not proof of an edge.
limitations: Hypothesis template only. No evidence has been computed for this idea. Historical membership, delisted coverage, action completeness and daily-bar execution detail may be unavailable.
